title: From Strategy Search to Policy Learning: MCTS-Guided Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2511.19218v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly power web-facing applications, including conversational assistants and content services, where open user interaction exposes them to diverse safety threats and adaptive attacks. In particular, jailbreak attackers repeatedly reformulate harmful requests to bypass safety alignment. Although existing studies have concentrated on defending dynamic jailbreaks, they often retain discovered attacks as flat samples and discard information about how those attacks were found. Its search component, GS-MCTS, explores multi-step compositions of rewriting operators and associates discovered attacks with empirical success frequency and path depth. translated_title: 从策略搜索到策略学习：面向大语言模型安全对齐的MCTS引导对抗协同进化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益为各类面向网络的应用提供支持，包括对话助手和内容服务。在这些应用中，开放式的用户交互使模型面临多样的安全威胁与自适应攻击。尤其是，越狱攻击者会反复改写有害请求以绕过安全对齐。尽管现有研究聚焦于防御动态越狱攻击，但它们通常将已发现的攻击仅保留为扁平样本，丢弃了这些攻击是如何被发现的过程信息。在本文中，我们提出了MACE，一个由MCTS引导的对抗协同进化框架，它将搜索过程转化为攻击者与防御者双方的策略学习信号。其搜索组件GS-MCTS探索改写算子的多步组合，并将发现的攻击与经验成功频率和路径深度相关联；其优化组件AC-TGPO则利用这些统计信息进行难度感知的群体相关优化。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MACE框架，将MCTS搜索发现的攻击信息（成功频率与路径深度）转化为攻击者与防御者的策略学习信号，通过对抗协同进化提升大语言模型的安全对齐能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MACE, an MCTS-guided adversarial co-evolution framework that converts search-discovered attack statistics (success frequency and path depth) into policy-learning signals for both attacker and defender, thereby enhancing LLM safety alignment.
